blurb: CryptX is a student-driven project developed as part of an exploration into information security concepts.
description: CryptX is a student-driven project developed as part of an exploration into information security concepts. The application focuses on implementing encryption and steganography techniques, serving as a hands-on experiment with secure data handling. Built during academic studies in Information Technology, it showcases foundational knowledge in cryptography and secure communication practices.
